body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ''SPH-B5600'' its 7th T-DMB mobile phone whose display swivels to a horizontal position for video viewing. It features a 2M rotating camera, a 2.2-inch QVGA display, Bluetooth connectivity, TV-out, MicroSD external memory card slot, and a hot key for VOD/MOD/MP3 playback.
